Stop! Virgo, the stars are screaming at you right now.

Mercury is retrograde in Libra, squaring your natal Mercury in Virgo and stirring a tense opposition in your 10th House of career ambitions. Your ruling planet, Mercury, anchored in your Earth element, now moves through the Air and clashes with Virgoan precision, slowing your truth-telling.

With Venus in Libra activating your 7th House of partnerships, you might over-intellectualize a loved one's words tonight; watch for silent corrections instead of heated debates. Name one practical need you are avoiding.

In your 10th House, delay nonessential contracts, but trust your careful edits to strengthen tomorrow's important pitch. Your 6th House of daily work may feel scattered by rushed messages. Check your budget before any new investment.

Avoid signing urgent documents during this Mercury retrograde; instead, expect an unexpected blessing through a corrected audit.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
